input: Book a whale watching tour for the trip north

gold.taskTitle: Book a whale watching tour up north
gold.taskDescription: Research and book a whale watching tour for an upcoming trip to a northern destination.

questions.title: What is the exact destination for this trip?
questions.description: Identify the specific city, region, or coastal area up north where the tour should be booked.

questions.title: What dates do you need the tour booked for?
questions.description: Determine the specific date or date range when the whale watching tour should take place.

questions.title: How many people will be joining the tour?
questions.description: Get the total headcount to ensure correct booking capacity and pricing.

questions.title: Do you have a budget limit per person in mind?
questions.description: Understand any price constraints to filter suitable tour operators.

questions.title: Do you prefer a small private boat or large group vessel?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred tour format to narrow down operator options.

questions.title: Are there any accessibility or physical needs to accommodate?
questions.description: Identify any mobility, health, or comfort requirements that affect which tours are suitable.

questions.title: Is there a specific whale species or tour duration you want?
questions.description: Find out if the user has preferences around the length of the excursion or types of whales they hope to see.
